background_image_description: Full-bleed photograph across the canvas showing four people seated around a low table in a bright studio: at left a man in a color-block light gray and pale blue sweater, center-left a blonde woman in a black sweatshirt, center-right a man with long dark curly hair in a navy jacket over a white shirt, and far right a woman in glasses wearing a bright cobalt knit with orange-and-blue striped sleeves. White wall backdrop; scene cropped by a large off-white card overlay in the lower half.

nodes.asset_description: Top-to-mid canvas lifestyle photo of a collaborative meeting with four people as described; bright flash lighting, clean white wall background, table edges and hands visible near the bottom; vivid cobalt accents in clothing on the right.

nodes.svg_description: Off-white rectangular card with sharp corners covering the lower portion of the canvas; solid fill (#F7F7F7). Inside the card, a thin horizontal cobalt blue rule (#0A44FF) runs the full width about 24 px above the card’s bottom edge.
